description: Dependency policy: ARCHITECTURE.md §14.2. Electron security process: §14.3 and docs/releasing/patch-runbook.md.

packageRules.description: Everything waits for the weekend (UTC), and comes in groups, so updates don't fill CI's free runners while people's pull requests wait; and a pull request is rebased only when it conflicts (rebaseWhen), not on every push to main. Electron (below) and security fixes (vulnerabilityAlerts) don't wait.
Minor and patch updates in one weekly pull request, apart from the groups below (later rules win) and Electron.
Renovate can't check release age for these update types, so 7 days would hold them back forever. Pins only freeze what we already use; lock file maintenance PRs are reviewed by a person.
Electron ships Chromium security fixes: no waiting, no PR rate limits, first in line. Automerge patch and minor once every CI check passes (ARCHITECTURE.md §14.2).
Electron majors need a person: breaking changes every 8 weeks.
